Free.

Look up a single Google Maps category by name (French or English), with its number of places. To build a target, use suggest_categories instead; use this only to check or add one category id to search.categories.ids.

Free.

Same call as GET /api/v1/categories of the REST API.

tools.name: find_networks

Look up a brand, franchise or network by name. Use its id in search.filters.networks ({ "mode": "only" | "exclude", "ids": [...] }); mode "exclude" without ids removes every known network (independent businesses only).

Free.

Same call as GET /api/v1/networks of the REST API.

tools.name: get_search_metrics

The figures of a search in one call: total, places with an email address, a phone number, a website, and the estimated number of email addresses.

Free.

Same call as POST /api/v1/search/metrics of the REST API.

tools.name: preview_search

Up to 25 sample places of a search (name, city, category, rating, reviews). Contact details are booleans here: email addresses, phone numbers and websites only come with a list (create_list).

Free.

Same call as POST /api/v1/search/preview of the REST API.

tools.name: get_list_items
tools.description:
Rows of a ready list with every contact detail, page by page (nextCursor). Keep limit small (50 or less) and choose columns: large pages flood the conversation. For the whole list, use prepare_list_file.

Free.

Same call as GET /api/v1/lists/{id}/items of the REST API.

tools.name: get_list_file
tools.description:
Status of a prepared file. Once it is ready, "url" is a download link valid 120 seconds: download it at once or give it to the user, and call again for a new link.

Free.

Same call as GET /api/v1/lists/{id}/files/{fileId} of the REST API.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: suggest_categories, count_search, get_search_metrics, preview_search, estimate_list, create_list, get_list, complete_list, prepare_list_file, get_list_file, estimate_list_job, start_list_job, verify_list_emails · Private data: get_account, preview_search, create_list, get_list_items, prepare_list_file, get_list_file · Public sink: suggest_categories, count_search, get_search_metrics, preview_search, estimate_list, create_list, list_lists, get_list, complete_list, prepare_list_file, estimate_list_job, start_list_job, verify_list_emails.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: suggest_categories, count_search, get_search_metrics, preview_search, estimate_list, create_list, get_list, complete_list, prepare_list_file, get_list_file, estimate_list_job, start_list_job, verify_list_emails · Private data: get_account, preview_search, create_list, get_list_items, prepare_list_file, get_list_file · Public sink: suggest_categories, count_search, get_search_metrics, preview_search, estimate_list, create_list, list_lists, get_list, complete_list, prepare_list_file, estimate_list_job, start_list_job, verify_list_emails

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
